inspiration.observed_pattern: A recursive CTE repeatedly removes the first pipe-delimited token and inserts each token with its one-based depth into a temporary table.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a temporary import-token buffer. A recursive CTE splits a fixed deployment route string into ordered tokens, inserts the token text and position into a temporary table, and verifies the staged rows before the session ends. The source schema, identifiers, variables, and Orleans workflow are not copied.

fixture_notes: The route string contains three non-empty segments, including a repeated segment, so the recursive expansion must preserve both order and duplicate token text.
determinism_notes: The route literal, recursion termination condition, ordinal values, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE deployment_route_tokens (token_position INT NOT NULL, token_value VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: INSERT INTO deployment_route_tokens (token_position, token_value) WITH RECURSIVE route_parts (remaining, token_value, token_position) AS (SELECT SUBSTRING('west|relay|west', CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX('west|relay|west', '|', 1)) + 2, CHAR_LENGTH('west|relay|west')), SUBSTRING_INDEX('west|relay|west', '|', 1), 1 UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(remaining, CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining, '|', 1)) + 2, CHAR_LENGTH(remaining)), SUBSTRING_INDEX(remaining, '|', 1), token_position + 1 FROM route_parts WHERE remaining <> '') SELECT token_position, token_value FROM route_parts

checks.sql: SELECT token_position, token_value FROM deployment_route_tokens ORDER BY token_position
